name: KTM 390 Duke
engine: 373 or 399 cc liquid-cooled single, fuel injected
intro: A light, fun single. Several recent model years have throttle, fuel cap and ECU recalls.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2022-2023 bikes are in recall 26V196 (water in the e-throttle can cause loss of drive). 2024 bikes are in recall 25V740 (fuel cap seal leak). 2024-2025 bikes are in recall 25V825 (loss of drive power).
A-002.reason: Losing drive in traffic is dangerous. The fixes are free.

recalls.what: Water may enter the e-throttle unit and cause loss of drive power. Expands recall 25V598.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the throttle assembly free.

recalls.what: Fuel filler cap seal may crack and leak fuel.
